final: WITH mesh_with_sites AS (SELECT sm.zoneref, sm.facetfaces, s.entrystat FROM scanmesh sm LEFT JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(facetfaces AS REAL)) as baseline_val FROM mesh_with_sites WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL), site_avgs AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(CAST(facetfaces AS REAL)) as site_avg FROM mesh_with_sites WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg) as status_avg FROM site_avgs WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept_sites AS (SELECT sa.site_avg, st.status_avg, b.baseline_val FROM site_avgs sa INNER JOIN status_avgs st ON sa.entrystat = st.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.site_avg > st.status_avg) SELECT AVG(site_avg) as avg_kept_faces, AVG(site_avg - baseline_val) as avg_excess_baseline, AVG(site_avg - status_avg) as avg_excess_status FROM kept_sites
